items.title: How Much Upside Can ETN Stock's Growth Deliver?
items.summary: Data center sales are not supposed to grow like this inside a century-old industrial. Yet Eaton's sales to the segment surged about 65% last quarter. The company is aggressively reframing its business as an unparalleled portfolio from grid to chip to capture this demand. This is not the slow-growth electrical supplier many investors still imagine.
